record.reason: 一次要旨: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a widely adopted architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs), as it improves model capacity while limiting computational overhead through sparse expert activation. This property makes MoE-based LLMs particularly attractive for resource-constrained distributed environments. However, federated fine-tuning of MoE-based LLMs remains challenging under heterogeneous client data. Since
